question: What claim about classification is at stake in grouping innate, family-born, and door-guardian figures under a total class?
premises: Figures described as all-innate are posited.
Figures described as all-family-born are posited.
Figures described as all-door-guardians are posited as a related class.
inference: Three classes are presented together as forming a related total set in this context.
uncertainties: The relation between these three classes is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: All innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians are here set forth.
